issues.on_page: Balance Sheet - Governmental Funds, Total: Cash and Cash Equivalents 353,128; Cash at County Treasurer 6,516
issues.issue: ending governmental cash is printed (p7, Total column), but ending_cash is left null 'as in FY2023'. The 2026-11-06 ruling fills each measure where printed, and Albion/Alda fill ending_cash from the same balance-sheet line.

only the General Fund 37,610 is shown as Federal Receipts (budget schedule p20). The Park Fund 16,500 (capital grants, culture and recreation, p3) has no printed grantor but is counted as federal too.

customer deposits are usually refundable liabilities, but the report prints them as operating revenue and counts them in Charges for Services (p3). 'Deposits' is a context label, so the category needs the context check.

issues.on_page: Due to Other Funds 25,733 (eliminated in Adjustments)
issues.issue: the matching asset 'Due from Other Funds' is categorized Internal Balances, but this liability is other liabilities. Internal Balances would be consistent (also liabilities[4], the eliminations line).

the line mixes governmental and business-type receipts (it includes utility charges, loan proceeds and governmental local receipts), so tagging it all business-type is an assumption. The Total Primary Government 'Transfers' 109,502 (detail[11]) is likewise tagged governmental but covers both.

issues.on_page: Restricted for Grant Expenditures 60,741 (p2) vs 60,471 on the governmental funds balance sheet (p8)
issues.issue: the report's own statements disagree by 270 (offset in Unrestricted). Recorded as printed on the Statement of Net Position, which adds up, but there is no report_discrepancies entry.
